apiProducts.name: AS Account
apiProducts.description: Retrieves bulk account profile, account holder, and Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) information for all accounts which the user is authorized to access in the firm. The data is current as of the end of the previous business day. This is not a real time API. The data is persisted

apiProducts.name: AS Account Blocks
apiProducts.description: This API reserves and fetches all the account numbers for a given firm.

apiProducts.name: AS Account Inquiry
apiProducts.description: This API provides integrators with the ability to retrieve a list of all master accounts and sub-accounts. This service can be leveraged by third parties to enhance search and matching capabilities of Schwab accounts in integrations.

apiProducts.name: AS Account Synchronization
apiProducts.description: This API retrieves all the available accounts that have been updated after a given date and time.

apiProducts.name: AS Accounts Preferences and Authorizations
apiProducts.description: This API comprises account preferences and any account authorization objects on an account profile.

apiProducts.name: AS Address Change
apiProducts.description: The Digital Address Change API carries a data payload of Schwab client contact information from third party applications into Schwab Advisor Center to leverage address change functionality in Action Center. This service reduces the need to re-key contact details when changing the address of Schwab accounts.

apiProducts.name: AS Alerts
apiProducts.description: Retrieves and archives alerts on various account activities..

apiProducts.name: AS Balances
apiProducts.description: This API retrieves detailed balances on the account.

apiProducts.name: AS Client Inquiry
apiProducts.description: The Client Inquiry API retrieves Schwab client identifier data including client IDs, first name, last name, addresses, email addresses, phone numbers, and month/year of birth. This service can be leveraged by third parties to enhance search and matching capabilities of Schwab clients in integrations.

apiProducts.name: AS Cost Basis
apiProducts.description: This API provides detailed cost basis information on Schwab account transactions.

apiProducts.name: AS Daily Data
apiProducts.description: This API provides the daily account balances and positions data as of the previous business day.It enables the user with the ability to download and persist high volumes of data at the firm level.

apiProducts.name: AS Digital Account Open
apiProducts.description: Export client and prospect information from third-party applications into the Schwab Advisor Center Digital Account Open tool.

apiProducts.name: advisor-services-as-digital-onboarding-d402805f-67cd-48e5-946c-2c65e544b8e1
apiProducts.description: A RESTful API that supports Digital Onboarding, enabling firms to create, validate, submit, and manage onboarding envelopes, maintain contacts, and open accounts digitally. The service also supports ACH, Transfer of Assets (TOA), and Beneficiary workflows as contingent actions, as well as Advisor Document uploads and Contra Party services used to support asset transfer and onboarding workflows.

apiProducts.name: AS Document Preferences
apiProducts.description: Valuable client document preference information for a single or an array of client accounts.

apiProducts.name: AS Feature Enrollment
apiProducts.description: Get the enrollment status for a Firm

apiProducts.name: AS Man Fees File Upload
apiProducts.description: This API uploads management fee files to Schwab Advisor Center

apiProducts.name: AS MCP
apiProducts.description: Product that exposes the MCP Proxy as tools

apiProducts.name: advisor-services-as-move-money-74457754-2774-4f95-8ad2-b2aaed1ed3f8
apiProducts.description: A RESTful service that supports Move Money workflows, enabling firms to initiate ACH and Wire transfers for taxable, IRA, and Trust (PTRS) accounts. The service supports standing-authorized, one-time transfers and recurring transactions.

apiProducts.name: AS Move Money Activity
apiProducts.description: Retrieves move money activity info

apiProducts.name: AS Move Money Transfers
apiProducts.description: Creates move money transfers

apiProducts.name: AS Positions
apiProducts.description: This API can be used to view the position details of a single account or multi-accounts.

apiProducts.name: AS Profiles
apiProducts.description: Request account Profile information for a single or multiple client accounts.

apiProducts.name: AS Reports
apiProducts.description: This API retrieves client statements, trade confirmations, and year-end tax documents.

apiProducts.name: AS Service Request
apiProducts.description: Creates service requests based on the retrieval and selection from a list of topics and sub-topics

apiProducts.name: AS Standing Authorizations
apiProducts.description: Returns custodial records for Standing Authorizations. Standing Authorizations are the authorized and approved asset transfer templates which advisor uses to initiate an asset transfer transaction.

apiProducts.name: AS Status
apiProducts.description: Status API provides status information on various categories of requests, such as service requests, account open requests, and more. This API can be used to filter and sort status data more easily based on it's functionality and response object format

apiProducts.name: AS Trading
apiProducts.description: With this API perform these five operations on trading orders: Submit Order, Get Order Status, Cancel Order, Cancel and Replace Order, and Save Orders to Blotter.

apiProducts.name: AS Trading File Upload
apiProducts.description: This API helps upload trade and allocation files to Schwab Advisor Center

apiProducts.name: AS Transactions
apiProducts.description: Retrieves a list of transactions for the account.

apiProducts.name: AS User Authorization
apiProducts.description: Retrieves a list of user authorizations and an indicator for whether the user is a Firm Security Administrator.
